column1: # Howdah package layouts beyond the original two (Surý/Debian apt and Remi SCL
# yum, which packaging/deb/build-deb.sh and packaging/rpm/build-rpm.sh still
# build unchanged). packaging/build-layouts.sh renders one package per row from
# the SAME per-minor release tarball (same howdah.so, same howdah.ini); only the
# install paths, ini drop-in, package name and dependencies differ. A new layout
# is a new row. Vendor sources for every path: docs/packaging-layouts.md.
# Tab-separated, one row per (layout, package format). Tokens:
#   @MINOR@ 7.4   @XY@ 74   @API@ Zend module API (20190902)   @REL@ package revision
#   @MODDIR@ (ext column only) the row's moddir
# Columns:
#   layout    name howdah-check detect prints for this kind of PHP
#   fmt       rpm | deb
#   arches    release arches built for this row (x86_64, aarch64; deb maps to amd64/arm64)
#   package   package name
#   release   rpm Release / deb revision suffix (@REL@ alone, or with a tag to keep NEVRAs unique)
#   moddir    where howdah.so is installed (the vendor PHP's extension_dir)
#   ext       value written into `extension=` in the ini (relative unless extension_dir varies)
#   inis      comma-separated ini drop-ins (each gets the same howdah.ini, config(noreplace)/conffile)
#   requires  comma-separated rpm Requires / deb Depends; pins the PHP minor (and so its ABI)
#   repo      repository path under https://pkg.howdah.org/ (the format's apt/ or yum/ goes below it)
#   label     human name used in the package summary
